# Maybee Creations

> Creatively Crafted educational discovery world maps and adventure guides for faith, freedom, frontier, farlands, and the AI future.

Maybee Creations (https://maybeecreations.com) is a digital creation studio that makes printable study maps paired with adventure guidebooks. Laminate a map for repeated use. Products span five realms: Faith (Soul Explorer Bible maps), Freedom (Liberty Explorer civics maps), Frontier (Frontier Explorer science, literature, music, missionary, and liberty maps), Farlands (Farlands Explorer country map kits), and Future (Tomorrow Explorer AI learning maps).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://maybeecreations.com/): Overview of all five realms and downloadable educational maps
- [Faith](https://maybeecreations.com/faith): Soul Explorer Bible book category maps, Life Of character maps, and adventure guides
- [Freedom](https://maybeecreations.com/freedom): Liberty Explorer civics, founding figures, and American history maps
- [Frontier](https://maybeecreations.com/frontier): Frontier Explorer maps of Einstein, the Odyssey, Mozart, Shakespeare, Tesla, and more
- [Farlands](https://maybeecreations.com/farlands): Farlands Explorer gallery of 50 country kits. Each kit is an illustrated study map, guidebook, and audio tour ($7.77): Argentina, Australia, Austria, Brazil, Cambodia, Canada, China, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, Ethiopia, France, Germany, Greece, Guatemala, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Iran (Persia), Iraq, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Mali, Mexico, Mongolia, Morocco, Nepal, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States, Uzbekistan, and Vietnam
- [Future](https://maybeecreations.com/future): Tomorrow Explorer AI realm maps with Adventure Pack tutorials
- [Stories](https://maybeecreations.com/stories): Essays on the history and meaning behind the maps
- [Shop](https://shop.maybeecreations.com): Shopify storefront for Faith, Freedom, Frontier, Farlands, and Future printable map downloads
- [Farlands collection](https://shop.maybeecreations.com/collections/farlands): Shopify Farlands realm collection

## What we make

Educational discovery world maps are printable study maps paired with guidebooks full of prompts, missions, and reflections. They are designed for families, homeschoolers, students, teachers, and curious adults. Print a map and laminate it for repeated use.

## Stories (blog)

- [Why We Map Stories](https://maybeecreations.com/stories/why-we-map-stories)

## Audience

Families, homeschoolers, K-12 students, civics teachers, science and literature learners, expedition explorers, and beginners learning AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
